servicesSummary: Liberia Ministry of Foreign Affairs Registrant advised the foreign principal on Liberia's bid to join (through vanguard Africa) the UN Security Council. Mr. Mohamed Bazoum The registrant developed a website and collateral for the Free Bazoum campaign. The Registrant also reprinted / linked media stories about Bazoum's detention on the website but was not involved in pitching any of the news stories or speaking with members of the media or other stakeholders.
moneyExplanation: The supplemental statement reports $25,000.00 in total receipts for this registrant during the filing period. These are registrant-level filing totals and are not automatically attributable to any one foreign principal.
